name: Furen Longbeard
summary: In Stormwind’s Dwarven District, warriors seek Furen Longbeard’s skill with battle-ready armor. Apprenticed to Grimand Elmore, he is known for his skill with metal and heavy protective gear.

sections.title: A Dwarven Smith in the Human Capital
sections.body: Furen Longbeard works far from Ironforge’s great forges, in Stormwind’s Dwarven District. Like many dwarves, he brought the old ways of working metal south to help rebuild and defend the kingdom. His craft connects him with artisans across the city and beyond.

sections.title: Mastery of Fire-Hardened Mail
sections.body: Grimand Elmore taught Furen Longbeard his craft. Furen has perfected ways to treat heavy mail and plate so they can withstand the blows of battle. Young warriors turn to him for durable protection. To make his fire-hardened armor, he needs rare ores, special components and exotic reagents from distant corners of the world.

faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a dwarven armorer in Stormwind City’s Dwarven District. Alliance warriors turn to him for mastercrafted mail armor and guidance.

faq.q: Where can Furen Longbeard be found?
faq.answer: You can find Furen Longbeard in Stormwind City’s Dwarven District, near its forges and smithing workshops.

faq.q: Who taught Furen his smithing craft?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore taught Furen Longbeard armorcraft and metallurgy. He is a respected veteran craftsman who also lives in the Dwarven District.

faq.q: What armor is Furen famous for crafting?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is known for crafting Fire Hardened Mail. He makes this resilient armor through careful metalwork with rare components gathered across the continent.

faq.q: Is Furen Longbeard related to other Longbeards?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard shares his clan name with other prominent dwarves across the Eastern Kingdoms, including Pilot Longbeard, an Ironforge siege engine pilot. Furen’s craft is smithing.

faq.q: Why do warriors seek out Furen Longbeard?
faq.answer: Warriors who have proven their basic martial prowess are directed to Furen Longbeard for heavy, durable armor. It can endure front-line combat against deadlier threats.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you can turn to Furen Longbeard for fire-hardened armor made with gathered reagents and his smithing skill.
As a blacksmith, you can see the high standards of dwarven smithing in Stormwind. Grimand Elmore passed his advanced techniques down to Furen Longbeard.
As a dwarf, you can see Furen Longbeard keeping dwarven metalworking traditions alive in the heart of the human capital.
